title: Hold jobs on low disk before checks instead of failing them
summary: The free-disk guard before the checks (and before the verifier) closes the job failed with `environment: low disk` and needs `athena retry`. Change it so that low space after cleanup leaves the job held and resumable from its built candidate, shown in `athena status`. A later drain pass resumes it by itself once space is back, with no retry and no work-failure count. This follows up job 20261025-033738-yz2d (which hit this guard) and job 20261025-202447-xgk9 (an earlier disk-full loss, closed as superseded). The audience is the maintainer running drains and the verifier running cargo test.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria require new passing tests plus clippy and fmt.
Criteria check the job held, then resumed, with no retry, by running tests.
Fixes the late guards that still fail the job, rather than only retrying the one job.
The hold and resume behavior is enforced in code and tests, not prose.
One focused change on the disk guard; the proposing work and other jobs are excluded.
The check is that a drain no longer ends a job failed on low disk and resumes it by itself.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: crates/athena-core/src/disk.rs already holds a job at dispatch (gate, sweep_idle_targets, write_hold, LowDisk) and does idle-build cleanup. crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs check_and_verify (about line 1180) and crates/athena-core/src/run/verification.rs (about line 130) still close the job failed with an `environment: low disk` reason before the checks and before the verifier. crates/athena-core/src/disk.rs resumable_stop and is_environment_reason, plus ResumeMark in crates/athena-core/src/state.rs, mark which failed jobs `athena retry` resumes. crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs gives each item two attempts and treats a dispatch hold (`run.held`) as not a failure.

Reading of the work: the two late guards keep the built candidate and write the resume mark, then end the job in a held state that is not Failed. That state shows the reason in `athena status`, never counts as a work failure in introspection or failure classes, and does not use up a drain attempt. A later drain pass re-checks disk and resumes from the candidate with no new producer run. The existing dispatch hold, the cleanup sweep and the `athena retry` path for old failed environment jobs stay.
No new record schema or data file under crates/ is planned. If the producer adds one, it must be covered by check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test.

Job 20261025-033738-yz2d (automatic proposing) is not re-done here. Its candidate's 8 files are not part of this change and are excluded below; that work is neither kept nor dropped by this change. Job 20261025-202447-xgk9 was closed as superseded and had no candidate, so nothing carries over from it.

Disk is simulated in tests with the existing ATHENA_FREE_BYTES hook (disk.rs FREE_BYTES_ENV) and with_min_free_gb in crates/athena-cli/tests/common/mod.rs. This adds no refusal rule on readings, so no newly-refused-readings percentage applies.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`. A new test with simulated low space (ATHENA_FREE_BYTES) after the build shows the job ends held and not Failed: no `athena retry` is needed, no verifier or producer verdict is recorded, and the outcome text names `environment: low disk` with the free and required amounts.

Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`. A new test shows a later drain pass, once the simulated free space is raised, resumes the held job from its kept candidate with no new producer run and no `athena retry`, and the job finishes.
Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`. A new test shows space that stays short across passes leaves the job held and uses up no drain attempt. Each of these tests fails on the pre-change code.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core`. A test shows a low-disk hold before the checks and before the verifier is not counted as a work failure in introspection or failure classes, and that the idle-build cleanup still runs first and lets the job proceed when it frees enough space.
Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test binary` or the status tests. `athena status` shows the held job with its low-disk reason and the amounts.

Grep of crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs and crates/athena-core/src/run/verification.rs shows the low-disk path no longer calls `self.failure(` with a `before the checks` or `before the verifier` retry message.

CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the hold-and-auto-resume behavior, and the module docs in crates/athena-core/src/disk.rs and crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs describe the new behavior instead of the old fail-and-retry.
Run `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`. All pass (the standing `tested` default).
Governance files are unchanged: athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows, and the Cargo and toolchain files are not in the diff.

out_of_scope: Automatic proposing after introspection (the work of job 20261025-033738-yz2d): its 8 changed files (CHANGELOG.md aside) are not part of this change. These are crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs, crates/athena-cli/tests/introspection.rs, crates/athena-cli/tests/proposals.rs, crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs, crates/athena-core/src/proposals.rs, and its edits to drain.rs and tests/drain.rs. That job is rerun separately.
The test-suite speedup and the other work of job 20261025-202447-xgk9 (its docs/decisions.md, secrets.rs, checks.rs and test-file scope)
Guarding the combined disk use of jobs started in parallel, or planning around disk
Changing the [disk] min_free_gb default or config schema, or editing athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows
Deleting committed records or touching a running job's files in the cleanup
Removing `athena retry` or its handling of old failed environment jobs
departures: Higher cost and time than the reference: the change touches the run pipeline, drain and status, and needs several simulated-disk tests. It is also riskier because it changes the close and resume path.
urgent_reason: Cuts failed jobs and manual retries: disk exhaustion caused three failures between Oct 23 and 26, and job yz2d failed before its checks on low disk.
hard_reason: Changes a gate that refuses or holds work (the free-disk guard) and the run pipeline's close and resume path, so a mistake is costly or hard to see.
